descriptions.d27h_axis_input_dispatch_800a7148: Analog axis event dispatch: zeroes values inside the dead zone at +88, derives stepped level and threshold flags, then for each entry from +164 to +168 of the table at +172 (all, or only active ones unless bit 10 of +96 is set) finds items of kind 1 bound to the event button and device, and sends the level, press and entry-name messages according to the item's mode, recording level and state.
